bhcoe_body: BlueMind Therapy holds Full Accreditation from the Behavioral Health Center of Excellence (BHCOE), the accrediting body for ABA therapy providers. We have been accredited since 2023, and our current accreditation runs through May 2027.
bhcoe_check_1: Clinical quality reviewed by an independent accrediting body
bhcoe_check_2: Staff qualifications, training and supervision checked against national standards
bhcoe_check_3: Families and staff surveyed as part of every review
bhcoe_scope: Accredited locations: Ypsilanti and Fort Gratiot.
